items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I imagine Johnny Carson might say something about him, because when he became 90 and he wasn't even here, Carson spoke of it, you know.

ctx.x: But it was good to see him, and he was sparkling like he does.

Well, I think he did a -- he was on A.M. the other morning, they had a birthday cake for him, and I imagine Johnny Carson might say something about him, because when he became 90 and he wasn't even here, Carson spoke of it, you know.
